raw_launch_layout: launches/{id}.input.bin, .expected.bin, .output.bin; little-endian uint32 words. Input and full output contain 192 header/input words followed by 32 * component-count result words. expected contains only results. results.json per-launch actual_sha256 hashes output after 192 words; artifact manifest additionally hashes complete output files.

fresh_research.coverage: All 65,536 binary16 encodings occur once among 32 lane x 4 component slots of 512 full-mask batches per family/mode. Other 13 masks use 69 structured patterns only. Not exhaustive tuples, mask combinations, scalar caller placements or comparisons.
fresh_research.patterns: 25 constants, 25 permutations, 10 repeated patterns, distinct NaNs, alternating signed zeros, seven isolated NaN placements; raw words in inputs.json.
fresh_research.oracle: Independently derived integer binary16 classification and sign/magnitude ordering; both zero signs equal, NaN comparisons false; select unchanged second operand on tie/unordered. Model explicit source butterfly/ascending original-input scan and separate prefix transmitted state. No host floating arithmetic or source-output expectations.
fresh_research.seed_warning: Finite source seeds are not neutral mathematical extrema for infinities. Low2 all positive infinity exclusive MIN returns 7bff for both callers; all negative infinity exclusive MAX returns fbff.
fresh_research.half_data_path: Actual CUDA half overloads use ordered f16 comparisons, raw half2 packing/shuffle/low extraction and original-operand selection. PTX contains no f16<->f32 conversion; signaling/quiet NaN payloads and signs preserved in exercised source/control operations.

producer_consumer_trace: hlsl.meta.slang scalar/vector prefix and reduction overloads generate canonical GenericAsm; existing CUDA matrix reductions lower Array<vector<half,2>,2> with OutParam. Matrix prefixes lack CUDA capability.

Generated CUDA bitcasts ushort inputs into __half and calls WaveOpMin/Max templates; source half comparisons use __hlt/__hgt while shuffle overloads pack original bits. Finite exclusive seeds differ from FP64 infinity seeds.

_waveReduceScalar/Multiple use caller-seeded descending XOR stages on low contiguous power2 masks, ascending original-input scans otherwise; singletons preserve input. _wavePrefixScalar/Multiple maintain caller-seeded inclusive transmitted state separately from returned exclusive finite accumulator.

_getNVVMMaskedWaveScalarIdentity rejects half; _initializeNVVMMaskedWaveScalarOperation usesSourceMinMax currently admits FP32 reductions and FP64 reductions/prefixes. Both are emitter-owned bounded policy decisions; source shape is canonical.

Catalog half WAVE_READ_LANE_AT, ordered LESS_THAN/GREATER_THAN and SELECT are admitted; half numeric MIN/MAX are excluded. Provider uses raw i16<->i32 shuffle, FCmp OLT/OGT and raw SELECT; floating constants accept APFloat IEEEhalf bits. Existing source/direct controls pass.

responsible_boundaries.provider: No extension indicated. Numeric half MIN/MAX exclusion remains; ordered comparison/SELECT plus raw lane transport already suffice.
responsible_boundaries.constants: Use exact 7bff/fbff through existing semantic-width getFloatingPointConstant, not FP64 infinity seeds or numeric member-set extrema.
